The video opens with a man wearing a baseball cap and glasses, sporting a large beard, in front of a wall decorated with outdoor-themed items like a mounted fish, antlers, a shotgun, and a map with the name "Drew" on it. He is announcing an upcoming trip with his companion to the Mack Lake ORV area in Lupton, Michigan, and that they are going tarp camping before deer season starts. The scene then transitions to a first-person view from inside a vehicle, showing him driving on a wooded road. He then gets out of the vehicle, opens the back, and retrieves camping gear, including a muzzleloader. There are also a few clips that focus on the action of him loading the muzzleloader. The man is then seen putting an orange safety vest on himself and his dog. The man dons a backpack and carries the rifle as he begins to walk into the woods, followed by his dog. The camera then switches to a bird's eye view, which zooms out to show the man walking further into the woods.

The video segment provides an aerial view of a forest with trees in shades of green, red, and yellow, indicating it's autumn. A road winds through the center of the forest, with occasional trucks, ATVs, and people visible along the road. The segment opens with a dense view of the forest, transitioning to a clear area near the road where a white truck is parked. Soon after, two ATVs drive on the road. The camera zooms out to show more of the road winding through the forest and several trees with fall colors. Later, the ATVs drive up the road to another junction.

The video opens with a man with a large beard and glasses, dressed in a black t-shirt and hat bearing a logo, speaking directly to the camera with an expression of surprise. Behind him, on a rustic wooden wall, hangs a mounted fish, a deer skull, a shotgun, and a map with pins sticking out. The map has the word "DREW" printed on a label. The video cuts to a dark forest scene, then transitions to the same man, now wearing an orange vest, setting up a grey tarp and lighting a small cooking fire. Two ears of corn are placed on the fire. He prepares and eats corn and some heated vegetables from a pot. A brown dog wearing a purple harness watches him. In a tent at night, the dog noses at the man and some corn cobs in a black plastic bag. The video shifts to the next morning, revealing the dog and man together inside the erected tarp tent in daylight, in the woods. The man speaks to the dog: "Good Morning Sunshine" and then to the camera "we made it through the night baby". The end.

The video features a first-person perspective of someone walking through a dense, green forest, presumably looking for squirrels and things to photograph. The narrator mentions "Kara" whom they initially thought was doing the same. A figure in a red safety vest is visible in the distance. The camera then moves to a dog with brown fur, an orange collar, and a purple harness walking through the forest. The camera is mounted on the dog’s harness, providing a dog-level view of the environment. The dog walks through leaves and low-lying vegetation. As the dog moves forward, the individual in the red vest is seen again, with a camera and tripod set up. Throughout the video, the environment remains consistent: a dense forest with green trees and fallen leaves on the forest floor.

The video shows a woman in an orange vest and dark pants walking through a lush forest with dense trees. She also wears a brown hat and carries something that looks like a rifle on her left shoulder. The camera perspective then shifts to a dog, possibly wearing an orange vest, running through the forest, following the woman, as it is filmed from the dog's point of view. The forest is characterized by its green foliage, tall trees, and leaf-covered ground, indicating an autumn season, and the light suggests it's either early morning or late afternoon. The camera angle and movements convey a sense of following the woman through the forest.

The video shows a first-person perspective of someone walking through a forest in Michigan. Initially, the camera points toward the ground, displaying fallen leaves and foliage, and then pans upwards to reveal tall trees with green leaves, stretching towards the sky. The camera angle shifts further up to showcase the tops of the trees against the sky, giving a sense of depth and height within the forest. Later in the video, a person wearing an orange vest is visible in the distance, amidst the trees, giving scale to the size of the forest. The narrator comments about a porcupine that they say is one of the largest they’ve seen in Michigan, indicating the reason for the video recording.

The video segment begins with a close-up shot of a dark-colored porcupine nestled in the crook of a tree. The porcupine is partially hidden by the leaves of a small branch, and the camera angle is from below, looking upward. The leaves are green and lush, and the tree trunk is rough and textured. The camera slowly zooms out to reveal more of the surrounding forest, with tall trees and dappled sunlight filtering through the canopy. Finally, the video transitions to a shot of a brown dog, equipped with a red collar, trotting along a grassy slope in the woods. The dog appears to be hunting or exploring, and the overall environment is a peaceful and natural forest setting. There is a clear auditory sound of guitar music in the background.

He addresses the viewers, suggesting they like the video, subscribe to the channel, and ring the notification bell. He announces that he and "Dick" will be starting the deer season next week. He then expresses gratitude for reaching 500 subscribers. The man then encourages viewers to leave a comment about their favorite adventure from season 3 for a chance to win an apron from their merch store, where they also sell polos and hats. After saying "Thank you guys," the video cuts to an aerial shot of a group of people standing near several tents on a grassy bank next to a body of water, surrounded by trees. The logo of "MIAventureLife" with a tree in the center is superimposed over the group of people.
